name: mcp-apps-cli
description: Unofficial MCP Apps client for the Claude Code terminal: app UIs render inline, with clicks and keys forwarded to the app

appToolCalls.title: App tool calls
appToolCalls.description: When an MCP App calls one of its server's tools. rules (the default): follow your permission rules for that tool, asking where they would ask you. ask: always ask. allow: run it without asking unless your rules deny it, as Claude Desktop does. Your deny rules apply in every mode, and where your rules can't be checked for a tool you are asked.

appMessages.title: App messages
appMessages.description: When an MCP App sends Claude a message. ask: ask first, as Claude Desktop does, with a choice to allow that app's messages for the session. fill: put it in your prompt to edit and send. allow: send it at once.

offerFullscreen.title: Offer fullscreen
offerFullscreen.description: Claude Code passes MCP App views clicks and keys only in its fullscreen layout. ask: the first time a view opens on the main screen, offer once to switch (Claude Code restarts and resumes the conversation). never: don't offer.

offerBrowser.title: Offer a browser
offerBrowser.description: App views run in Chrome or another Chromium browser. ask: where none is installed, the first time a view can't open, offer once to download Chrome for Testing's headless shell from Google (about 100 MB, kept in the plugin's folder and updated). never: don't offer.
